node.label: Glucocortocoid-insensitive primary hyperaldosteronism
node.definition: A form of primary hyperaldosteronism in which the overproduction of aldosterone cannot be suppressed by the administration of dexamethasone or similar glucocorticoids.

evidence.snippet: Familial hyperaldosteronism type II: Glucocortocoid-insensitive primary hyperaldosteronism (frequency HP:0040281) [TAS]
